meta.name: youtube-thumbnail-design
meta.description: YouTube thumbnail design with specific dimensions, contrast rules, and mobile preview optimization. Covers safe zones, text placement, face expression psychology, and A/B testing. Use for: YouTube thumbnails, video cover images, click-through optimization. Triggers: youtube thumbnail, thumbnail design, video thumbnail, click through rate, ctr optimization, youtube cover, video cover image, thumbnail maker, thumbnail tips, youtube design, video preview image

copy.tagline: 设计高点击率的YouTube视频封面图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要制作吸引眼球的YouTube缩略图来提升视频点击率。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create eye-catching YouTube thumbnails to boost video click-through rates.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据 YouTube 缩略图设计规范（尺寸、对比度、安全区、文字规则、表情心理学等）生成或优化缩略图，并调用 AI 图像生成工具创建图片。
howto.when: 当你提到“YouTube 缩略图”、“缩略图设计”、“视频封面”、“点击率优化”等关键词，或要求设计/优化视频封面时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个教程视频的缩略图，突出惊喜表情。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合规范的缩略图描述或调用工具生成图片。

say.text: 优化这个缩略图：文字太多，颜色对比不够。
say.note: Claude 会检查并给出修改建议。

say.text: 生成一个产品对比的缩略图，左右分屏。
say.note: Claude 会调用 AI 生成对应风格的图片。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate or optimize YouTube thumbnails following design specs (dimensions, contrast, safe zones, text rules, face expression psychology, etc.) and call AI image generation tools to create images.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "YouTube thumbnail", "thumbnail design", "video cover", "click-through rate optimization", or ask to design/optimize a video cover.

say_en.text: Design a thumbnail for a tutorial video with a surprised expression.
Optimize this thumbnail: too much text, low contrast.
say_en.note: Claude will review and suggest improvements.

say_en.text: Generate a product comparison thumbnail with split screen.
say_en.note: Claude will call AI to generate a corresponding image.
